alert_news.title: IIT Hyderabad launches India’s first academic credit course on ‘Goodness’
bullets: India’s first academic credit course on ‘Goodness’ introduced by IIT Hyderabad, a public institution under the Ministry of Education
Course offers credit for learning about ethical values, social responsibility, and personal development, integrating moral education into higher learning

alert_news.title: IIM Udaipur launches India's first one-year full-time residential MBA in Investment and Wealth Management
bullets: India's first one-year full-time residential MBA in Investment and Wealth Management launched by IIM Udaipur
Program developed in collaboration with leading financial firms, unique to India, only IIM offering this specialized curriculum

alert_news.title: The Aditya-L1 Mission - INSIGHTS IAS - Simplifying UPSC IAS Exam Preparation
bullets: India’s first dedicated space‑based observatory mission, launched by ISRO on 2 September 2023, inserted into a halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L1 point on 6 January 2024, designed for a 5‑year operational life.

Carries seven scientific payloads (four remote‑sensing instruments – VELC, SUIT, SoLEXS, HEL1OS – and three in‑situ instruments – ASPEX, PAPA, magnetometers) to continuously observe the Sun’s photosphere, chromosphere and corona from ~1.5 million km, enabling uninterrupted study of solar flares, CMEs and space weather.
